claim: Static analysis is exhausted for the question "which code publishes the field at Engine.dll+0x421428", and the answer within the three shipped modules is: none is visible.

every_way_to_obtain_the_address.RIP-relative LEA into 0x4213c0..0x421490: 5 hits; two are the getter bodies themselves (0x31280, 0x4dd70), three belong to a different structure at 0x421450, none constructs or writes a field of the object at 0x4213e8
every_way_to_obtain_the_address.address-of getters (broadened to any des: 384 getters in the module; only two reach this region, and their combined callers number two, neither storing at any offset
every_way_to_obtain_the_address.absolute 32-bit immediate: 0 real hits; the two Game.dll matches were call rel32 displacements
every_way_to_obtain_the_address.base-plus-offset construction using the: 0 functions take a LEA of 0x4213c0 or 0x4213e8 and then store at the matching displacement (0x68 or 0x40)
every_way_to_obtain_the_address.relocation and static-initialiser tables: 7691 DIR64 entries, 552 runs, 51 function-pointer tables, 5362 entry functions scanned; 347 entries reference the region but none stores the slot

the_five_untouched_slots: 0x4213c0, 0x4213e8, 0x421418, 0x421420 and 0x421428 never receive a direct store, while every other slot in the region does. The last three are consecutive at 0x4213e8 + 0x30/+0x38/+0x40.
interpretation: The object at 0x4213e8 is never constructed and never written field-by-field in the static image, yet at run time its +0x40 field holds a live heap pointer. The publish therefore happens through a mechanism that leaves no address-carrying instruction in these three modules.
not_claimed: that the write does not happen
that a fourth module is responsible
that the client cannot be observed at start-up
boundary_statement: Both approved routes are complete. Route A and route B, plus four follow-up hypotheses (getter indirection, cross-module writes, immediate forms, and alternative base plus displacement) are all negative. This is recorded as the boundary the objective asked for.
